description: Initialize the pnpm monorepo structure with all workspace packages, build tooling (turborepo, TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier), and the Next.js web application shell with TailwindCSS. This creates the complete project skeleton that all subsequent features build upon.
steps: Create a feature branch 'feat/mvp-foundation' from the current HEAD (empty repo). Make an initial commit on this branch.
Create root package.json with pnpm workspace configuration, scripts for build/dev/test/lint, and devDependencies for turborepo, typescript, eslint, prettier.
Create pnpm-workspace.yaml defining workspace packages: apps/*, packages/*
Create turbo.json with pipeline configuration for build, dev, test, lint tasks with proper dependency ordering.
Create root tsconfig.json as base TypeScript config with strict mode, path aliases.
Create root .eslintrc.js and .prettierrc with standard TypeScript/React rules.
Create root .gitignore for node_modules, .next, dist, .env.local, .turbo, coverage.

Create apps/web as a Next.js 14 App Router project: package.json (dependencies: next, react, react-dom, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, zustand, @tanstack/react-query, framer-motion), tsconfig.json extending root, next.config.js, tailwind.config.ts, postcss.config.js, app/layout.tsx (root layout with providers), app/page.tsx (landing page with 'Enter World' button), app/globals.css with Tailwind directives.
Create apps/web/app/game/page.tsx as the game page that will host the Phaser canvas.

Create packages/shared with package.json, tsconfig.json, src/index.ts exporting shared types (Player, Position, ChunkData, WorldConfig, GameEvent), src/constants.ts (TILE_SIZE=32, CHUNK_SIZE=16, WORLD_SEED), src/utils.ts (coordinate helpers, chunk key generation).

Create packages/game-engine with package.json, tsconfig.json, src/index.ts as the ECS game engine entry point. Include stub files: src/ecs/World.ts, src/ecs/Entity.ts, src/ecs/Component.ts, src/ecs/System.ts for the ECS framework.
Create packages/database with package.json, tsconfig.json, src/index.ts, src/client.ts (Supabase client factory), src/types.ts (database types).
Create packages/ui with package.json, tsconfig.json, src/index.ts exporting shared UI components, src/Button.tsx, src/Card.tsx as basic components.
Create .env.example with NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY placeholders.
Run pnpm install to verify all dependencies resolve. Run pnpm build to verify TypeScript compilation succeeds across all packages.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm install succeeds without errors at the repo root
pnpm build compiles all packages and the Next.js app without TypeScript errors
The monorepo has the correct workspace structure: apps/web, packages/shared, packages/game-engine, packages/database, packages/ui
A feature branch 'feat/mvp-foundation' exists with the initial commit
All packages can import from @worldnest/shared using workspace protocol
verification: Run 'pnpm install' at repo root and confirm exit code 0
Run 'pnpm build' and confirm all packages compile successfully
Run 'pnpm --filter @worldnest/web dev' briefly to confirm Next.js starts (then kill)
findings: All 5 workspace packages build successfully. Next.js dev server starts on port 3000. ESLint warns about missing Next.js plugin in eslint config (non-blocking). Installed package versions: turbo 2.10.7, typescript 5.9.3, next 14.2.35, eslint 8.57.1. The tsconfig.tsbuildinfo files are generated in each package during build. The @worldnest/database package required explicit @types/node devDependency for process.env usage.
